thought.text: Site is installed and bootstrapping successfully. Let me verify the distribution modules are enabled, the site renders over HTTP, and admin access works.

reasoning_content:
The site has been installed and is in a working state:
- Drupal version: 11.3.17
- Bootstrap: successful
- Install profile: openculturas
- Default theme: opcult
- DB: connected (MySQL 8.0)
- PHP 8.4.24

Next, let's verify that the OpenCulturas profile is properly enabled, that the site renders in a browser (HTTP check), and generate a ULI to prove that the admin backend is working.

action.command:
cd /workspace
echo "=== key OpenCulturas modules enabled? ==="
runuser -u dev -- ddev drush pm:list --enabled --no-components -y 2>/dev/null | grep -iE "openculturas|geocoder:geocoder |leaflet|smart_date|address" | head -20
echo "=== HTTP check homepage ==="
runuser -u dev -- ddev curl -s -o /dev/null -w "HTTP %{http_code}\n" http://localhost/ 2>&1
runuser -u dev -- ddev curl -s -o /dev/null -w "HTTP %{http_code}\n" http://openculturas.ddev.site/ 2>&1
echo "=== homepage title ==="
runuser -u dev -- ddev curl -s http://localhost/ 2>/dev/null | grep -oE "<title>[^<]*</title>" | head -2
